entry.title: Development :: RE: Long lost cheat codes
entry.dc:creator: bbayles
entry.dc:subject: Development
entry.content:
Author: bbayles
Posted: Thu Nov 12, 2026 12:46 pm (GMT 0)

I just wrote up a new cheat for The Adventures of Batman & Robin:

  • During gameplay, press Press Right, Left, Right, Left, Right, Left, Right.
  • Hold 1 and press Start. Coordinate will appear onscreen.
  • Hold 1 and press the D-pad to move Batman through walls and floors
  • Hold 1+Start and press Left/Right to change the stage number. Press 2 to warp to the selected stage.


There were previously Action Replay codes to enable these features, but I think the button sequence method is new!

I also figured out part of what's going on with the mysterious "FUCKS CRACKS SONY1" strings in the game data. They're special passcodes! You have to enter them as "FTCKS CQACK SNNY1", since the game alters the second character before checking. They don't do much, however - each one takes you to a different level, but nothing beyond that. Strange![/list]
